text:
sre_ci_bot: PAGER — edenbridge_prod_vpc (tenant: edenbridge). Severity: P1. Observed: spike in 5xx + p99 generation latency jumped from 2.1s -> 9.8s. Error rate ~12%. Affected pool: dedicated-pool-9 (gpu: a100). Playbook: <https://redwood.internal/playbooks/tenant-fallback>

oncall_tina: Paging in — joining incident call now :phone:

devon: looking at dashboards — QPS steady, errors concentrated on model variant `v2-quant-08b`. KV cache growth looks abnormal on nodes serving that variant.

maria_l: Customer (EdenBridge) says interactive sessions are timing out, some partial completions. They asked for a safe fallback if we have one.

alex_r: We have `v1-stable-8b` as a tested safe variant with lower mem pressure. Recommend routing a canary to that before full swap.

edenbridge_sre: We prefer rolling with minimal session interruption. Can we do 20% canary to start? Need TTL for override and visibility on session affinity.

oncall_tina: Plan: start canary 20% -> monitor 5m metrics (5xx, tail latency, kvcache evict) -> if green, ramp to 100% with 5m watch. I'll apply override with short TTL.

oncall_tina: Applying override now (command):
```
/redwood override create --tenant edenbridge --route text-generate --from-model v2-quant-08b --to-model v1-stable-8b --weight 20 --ttl 30m --meta "incident:safevariant-canary"
```

devon: saw the routing policy change propagate to two nodes. Logs: decreased OOM/evict churn on canary nodes within 90s. 5xx on canary nodes down to ~1.2% from 12%.

maria_l: EdenBridge SRE: initial customer traffic on canary sessions looks normal. A handful of older sessions still hit errors (session tokens pinned to original nodes).

edenbridge_sre: We can accept a short canary, then do full routing for new sessions only if needed. Avoid touching pinned long-lived sessions.

alex_r: If we need to force-pin older sessions, we can trigger a staged session-migrate flow, but that will cause replays for users. Prefer avoid.

oncall_tina: Given metrics and customer agreement, ramping to 100% for new requests, keeping session affinity intact for existing pinned sessions.

oncall_tina: Update command (ramp):
```
/redwood override update --tenant edenbridge --route text-generate --to-model v1-stable-8b --weight 100 --apply_to new_requests_only --ttl 2h
```

devon: Metrics: global 5xx down to 0.9%, p99 now 2.3s. KV cache evictions back to baseline on most hosts. Looks stable.

maria_l: Customer confirms degraded UX resolved for majority. They're monitoring edge cases for long sessions. :thumbsup:

edenbridge_sre: We'll follow up with a list of session IDs experiencing failures. Also request audit logs for model swap and routing TTL.

alex_r: I'll attach the override audit and flag for postmortem. Action items: 1) investigate why `v2-quant-08b` caused kvcache pressure 2) add canary gating to autosuggest earlier 3) write runbook note for tenant-safevariant flow.

oncall_tina: Creating incident summary and tagging owners. Will schedule a post-incident with SRE + ML infra + Customer SRE. Thanks all.

sre_ci_bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated. Severity downgrading to P2 pending postmortem. Link: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/5300001234>

maria_l: Adding note: consider making `v1-stable-8b` available as an automated safe-variant in routing policy for enterprise VPCs.

edenbridge_sre: Appreciate quick response. We'll replay edge sessions tomorrow with your SREs. Closing our side once audit received.

oncall_tina: Logged. Closing incident thread once postmortem created. :sparkles:
